Reid Roadster | 20 inch kids' bike
Ready for their next adventure, the Reid Roadster 20" Kids' Bike is a stylish and dependable choice for 7–9 year olds ready to take their riding to the next level. Combining timeless vintage styling with child-friendly components, it's designed to make every ride fun, comfortable and confidence-building.
Inspired by classic vintage bikes, the Roadster 20" features a stylish design with quality components built for everyday riding. It's an ideal step up for young riders who have moved on from training wheels and are ready to explore further on two wheels.
Safety and control are key. The dual-pivot alloy front brake provides reliable stopping power, while the rear coaster brake offers simple, intuitive stopping by pedalling backwards, helping young riders stay in control as their confidence grows.
Whether they're riding to the park, exploring the neighbourhood or joining a family bike ride, the Reid Roadster 20" is built to provide a comfortable, confident and enjoyable ride.
Who is the Roadster for?
The Roadster 20" Kids' Bike is ideal for:

7–9 year olds ready for a larger kids' bike
Young riders who have moved on from training wheels
Children developing confidence and independence on two wheels
Kids who love classic, vintage-inspired bike styling
Parents looking for a safe, reliable and stylish kids' bike
Everyday adventures, from park trips to family bike rides

Find the right fit
Choosing the right bike size helps your child ride comfortably, confidently and safely. Use our Kids' Bike Size Guide by clicking the tab above to find the right Reid bike based on your child's height and age.
